name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=wait/timing primitive). Accurately describes behavior: wait up to N BIOS ticks OR any keypress, while keeping the palette-cycle animation running. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Wait up to max_ticks BIOS ticks (18.2 Hz) or until any key is pressed, driving the palette-cycle animation throughout; drains the keyboard buffer on exit.
logic_summary: start_tick = sign-extended 16-bit BIOS tick word [0x46C]. Loop: call fd2_update_palette_cycle_anim(); keypress = fd2_check_keyboard_buffer_nonempty(); re-read current tick; if (current_tick - start_tick >= max_ticks) OR (current_tick < start_tick, i.e. tick wraparound/rollover) force keypress=true (timeout). Repeat until keypress. On exit call fd2_clear_keyboard_buffer(). Disassembly confirms: MOVSX ESI,word[0x46C] for start; SUB EAX,ESI / CMP EAX,EDI / JGE for elapsed>=max_ticks; CMP EAX,ESI / JGE for the wraparound guard; CALL 0x4e031 = clear buffer.

params.name: max_ticks
params.semantics: Timeout duration expressed in BIOS midnight ticks (~55 ms each, 18.2 Hz). The wait returns when elapsed ticks reach this value or earlier on a keypress. Caller fd2_process_xp_and_level_up_for_char passes 0xB (~600 ms) for the level-up 'press a key to continue' pause. (C source already declares this as 'max_ticks'; Ghidra side is param_1 and would be renamed to max_ticks in Stage 2.)
params.reason: The C declaration already names it max_ticks, which accurately reflects its use as the tick-count timeout. The Ghidra param_1 placeholder maps to this and is the only thing needing a Stage-2 rename; the source name is correct as-is.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effects are the elapsed wait, continuous palette-cycle animation, and a cleared keyboard buffer.

reads_globals: BIOS_TICK_WORD (BDA 0:046C, 18.2 Hz midnight tick counter, read sign-extended as int16)
writes_globals: BIOS keyboard buffer state via fd2_clear_keyboard_buffer (sets BDA tail [0x41C] = head [0x41A])
comment_original_issue: None; the existing src comment block (lines 428-434) already states the purpose, palette-keep behavior, and buffer-clear-on-exit concisely and correctly.
notes: Equivalence between src and binary already verified upstream; this pass only confirmed naming/comment accuracy. Three call sites confirmed via xrefs: fd2_tick_status_effects_and_show_messages (0x1a92f, 0x1aa02) and fd2_process_xp_and_level_up_for_char (0x1e506). src comment and Ghidra plate are mutually consistent (plate is more detailed, src is the concise canonical form); no edits to input.c or the plate were needed.
